mapper.select: SELECT DATABASE() database_name, @@port port, NOW(3) database_time
SELECT id,username FROM bike_sys_user WHERE username='admin' AND enabled=1
SELECT * FROM bike_production_template ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_product_model WHERE model_code LIKE #{pattern}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_vehicle SET vehicle_qr_code=#{qrCode},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{vehicleId} AND frame_sn=#{frameSn} AND vehicle_qr_code IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_production_print(id,vehicle_id,snapshot,status,reason,created_by,created_at,finished_at,message) VALUES(#{printId},#{vehicleId},#{snapshot},'FAILED','演示数据：未连接打印设备',#{operator},#{createdAt},#{createdAt},'演示记录，未向任何打印机发送任务')

INSERT INTO bike_production_scan_failure(task_id,scanned_code,expected_type,operator_name,error_code,reason,created_at) VALUES(#{taskId},#{code},'MOTOR',#{operator},'PART_NOT_FOUND','演示：电机编码尚未登记',#{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT 'fourCodeBindings' name,COUNT(*) violations FROM bike_vehicle v WHERE v.frame_sn LIKE #{pattern} AND ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b WHERE b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.is_current=1) != 3 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_production_scan s JOIN bike_production_task t ON t.id=s.task_id WHERE t.vehicle_id=v.id) != 4) UNION ALL SELECT 'orderShippedQuantity',COUNT(*) FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.order_no LIKE #{pattern} AND i.shipped_qty != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_record r WHERE r.order_id=o.id AND r.status='COMPLETED') UNION ALL SELECT 'stockHistory',COUNT(*) FROM bike_vehicle v WHERE v.frame_sn LIKE #{pattern} AND ((v.status IN (2,3) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_stock_in_record r WHERE r.vehicle_id=v.id AND r.status='COMPLETED')) OR (v.status=3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_stock_out_record r WHERE r.vehicle_id=v.id AND r.status='COMPLETED')) OR (v.assemble_time > v.stock_in_time) OR (v.stock_in_time > v.stock_out_time)) UNION ALL SELECT 'reservationQuantity',COUNT(*) FROM bike_order_reservation r JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN bike_order_reservation_item si ON si.order_id=o.id WHERE o.order_no LIKE #{pattern} AND (r.reserved_qty!=i.ordered_qty OR si.ordered_qty!=i.ordered_qty OR si.shipped_qty!=i.shipped_qty) UNION ALL SELECT 'livePrintJobs',COUNT(*) FROM bike_production_print WHERE id LIKE #{pattern} AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING')
